title: Expose the frozen missing-environment reason on native declared-run observation rows
outcome: The client-visible native declared-run row explains UNKNOWN with the same names-only missing-environment reason already carried by its frozen verdict and verification record.
acceptance: Use the existing native settlement owner to carry the frozen environment_missing:NAME reason into the observation detail without leaking values or changing artifact verdict/verification semantics.

A deterministic native-run fixture asserts missing selection yields UNKNOWN with the original missing name on the row and unchanged verification result, while configured and duplicate-start behavior remains intact.
